title: 完整小时日的金水日收益差异：保留缺失掩码的历史探索

priorKnowledge.amendmentReason: Official-source recovery can repair the recent missing archive but does not supply 18 historical complete days. Introduce a separate calendar-mask exploratory estimator rather than rewriting the old gap-free gate.
priorKnowledge.registrationMeaning: Freeze this revision, data hash and implementation hash before its first scoring run. This is an after-data-inspection amendment, not prospective preregistration.
priorKnowledge.unrecoveredDataCause: Use verified gap records. An absent or partial official bar alone does not prove the precise exchange outage cause.

calendarGrid.mask1Definition: Exactly 24 unique consecutive closed hourly bars with expected open/close timestamps, positive finite valid OHLC and verifiable same-exchange provenance; independently checked calendar label.
calendarGrid.mask0Definition: Any missing, conflicting, duplicate, partial, invalid or unverified constituent; retain the date and group, with return=null.
calendarGrid.recoveryPolicy: Identical duplicate copies may be de-duplicated only in an explicit provenance resolution step. Conflicting values are unresolved and mask=0; never prefer a source because its return is favourable.
calendarGrid.estimand: Delta_observed = mean(r | G=1, mask=1) - mean(r | G=0, mask=1). This is conditional on complete observed days; it does not estimate omitted-day returns without additional missingness assumptions.

qualityAndAvailability.coverageDenominator: all expected calendar dates in the fixed period
qualityAndAvailability.ifGatesFail: Report descriptive quantities and exact failure reasons; CI unavailable. Never change the period or masks to reach a gate.

bootstrap.prng: Python random.Random Mersenne Twister; actual interpreter version retained
bootstrap.N: number of all expected calendar days, including mask=0 dates
bootstrap.sampleConstruction: Sample starts uniformly with replacement; keep each 30-calendar-day block's ordered (G,mask,r) triples; concatenate and truncate to first N calendar rows. Never compress the input to complete days or require a block to be gap-free.
bootstrap.replicateStatistic: Compute the two means using sampled rows with mask=1 only; mask=0 retains a calendar position and contributes neither return nor valid count.
bootstrap.invalidReplicate: Either group's sampled valid count is zero; record invalid and do not redraw.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided 95% percentile interval; sorted (M-1)*p adjacent linear interpolation at p=0.025 and 0.975.
bootstrap.assumptionLimit: Approximate resampling uncertainty for observed complete-day associations. Transporting the historical missingness pattern does not make missingness random or remove dependence/nonstationarity, selection bias or prior result knowledge.

mandatorySensitivity.annualRows: Report every represented calendar year, marking 2026 as partial; group counts, expected/complete coverage, mean, median, sample sd, strictly-positive ratio, delta and deltaBp. Do not hide adverse years.
mandatorySensitivity.leaveOneYearOut: For each fixed period remove each represented calendar year in turn and report descriptive delta using remaining complete days; no bootstrap, no choosing a best omission, no shortened dates relabelled as the primary result.
mandatorySensitivity.extremeDayAudit: List 5 largest and 5 smallest valid daily returns per fixed period with date/group/source. This is influence inspection only; retain these days in every main estimate.
mandatorySensitivity.noExtraModels: No added zodiac, branch, birth-chart, moving-average, optimized block-length, time-zone, return-window or asset variants in this revision.

reporting.thresholdRole: Retain the old project's 10 bp screening reference as a descriptive arithmetic flag only, not an approved strategy or theory-validity status.
reporting.compareWithOldRun: Display old gap-free v0.1 failure beside this separate v0.2 result. The changed sample definition must remain prominent.

freezeAndRunManifest.validationEvidence: Resolve actual referenced hashes and tests; do not accept self-asserted boolean metadata as evidence.
